releaseNotes:
- UI Stability: Fixed critical issue with settings toggles disappearing during interaction.
- ELYSIUM Highlighting: World Boss rotations for ELYSIUM now feature a distinct primary glow and '(OUR TURN)' label.
- Premium Glassy UI: Refined translucent textures and gradient borders across all chips, toggles, and buttons.
- Theme-Aware Notifications: Integrated glassy top-notifications for a consistent feedback experience.
- Badge Optimization: Improved layout logic to prevent text wrapping on smaller screens.
